title: Jubilant Crunchy British Scamorza Trifle
description: A sweet and crunchy British dessert featuring scamorza, perfect for crowds, with a keto-friendly twist. It combines the flavors of Yorkshire with the creaminess of scamorza.
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the almond flour and granulated sweetener.
Add the sliced scamorza cheese to the bowl and toss until the cheese is evenly coated.
Spread the cheese mixture on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until crispy.
In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the bhuna sauce into the whipped cream until well combined.
In a large trifle dish, create a layer of the crispy scamorza cheese.
Add a layer of the whipped cream mixture on top of the cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of whipped cream on top.
Garnish with fresh berries and chopped nuts.
